difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a short exact sequence of quasi-coherent sheaves on X, WeakAss(F_2) is contained in WeakAss(F_1) cup WeakAss(F_3) and WeakAss(F_1) is contained in WeakAss(F_2) (source lines 614-624). The proof is the stalk reduction: at every point the sequence of stalks is a short exact sequence of modules over the local ring, and the corresponding algebra statement for modules gives both inclusions, the pointwise statement being exactly the assertion about sheaves because weak associativity is a property of stalks.
